messages:
maya: Heads up — Acme (org_zz123) reported their monthly token bucket hit zero twice today. UI showed a promo +5k at 2026-03-01T01:15Z but API requests kept getting 429s around 02:10. Anyone seen this pattern?

support-bot: Incident created INC-7892 for org_zz123 :rotating_light:

jordan: can you paste a sample curl + response headers? also which region and plan?

maya: here's the curl + headers we captured from their app: 
```
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"test"}'
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rw-credits-left: 0
x-rw-reset-at: 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z
```

emily: UI billing ledger shows promo applied (promo_5k) at 2026-03-01T01:15Z and balance +5000. Customer says they launched a long streaming job at ~01:50 and then started seeing 429s after reconnects.

sanjay: likely a cache/ordering race between the promo application job and quota-enforcement cache. Promo job writes DB, then a TTL-backed cache for billing/quotas may not be invalidated for enforcement path. The enforcement path reads a fast in-memory shard that only sees old state -> 0 -> 429.

jordan: do we have the plan/upgrade timestamp? was this a pro monthly upgrade or a top-up?

maya: customer upgraded to Pro monthly at 2026-03-01T00:30Z (billing system shows successful change). Promo grant applied by billing pipeline at 01:15Z (promo_5k). They started the stream at 01:50Z, had a reconnect storm between 02:05–02:12Z.

emily: repro steps for us: 1) apply promo via billing job; 2) read enforcement cache immediately; 3) run generate calls with reconnects. If enforcement cache hasn't been refreshed, calls should 429 even though UI ledger says +5k.

support-bot: Suggested mitigation: short-term top-up (billing-ops) + temporary rate-limit bump for org_zz123 until cache clears.

billing-ops: please provide org id, promo id, and the billing tx id so we can correlate and optionally push a manual grant.

maya: org_zz123, promo_5k, tx_20260301_417.

sanjay: quick check you can run: 
```
# enforcement read (internal API)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_KEY" https://internal.redwood.com/v1/orgs/org_zz123/quota
# returns {"tokens_remaining":0, "last_write":"2026-03-01T00:31:00Z"} when stale
```
If stale, do a cache invalidate: `POST /admin/cache/invalidate?scope=org&key=org_zz123:billing` — after invalidate enforcement path should pick up DB row. TTLs: enforcement shard cache TTL=60s, billing cache write propagation async.

emily: billing-ops executed manual grant + cache invalidate at 02:10Z. Customer retried at 02:12Z and saw successful generation.

jordan: please capture the timing in logs for the promo job and the enforcement reads, we should add a check to fail-fast the enforcement path if DB shows grant but cache stale (or invalidate on promo write).

billing-ops: filing follow-up ticket to add synchronous cache invalidation for promo/top-up writes and to add a canary that opens an ephemeral enforcement read after any grant. Ticket: BILL-1327.

support-bot: Recommended temporary policy: for any plan upgrades between 23:30–01:30 UTC, automatically perform a cache invalidate and send a push notification to customers doing long-lived sessions.

maya: closing loop with Acme — they confirmed regen at 02:12 and are back online. Will follow up if it recurs. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
